name: White Chicken Chili
description: A quick, creamy Tex-Mex chili with shredded chicken, white beans, and green chiles.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt and freshly-ground black pepper
cilantro, tortilla chips, avocado, jalapeños, Monterey Jack cheese, sour cream

steps.text: Heat the oil in a large stockpot over medium-high heat. Add the onion and jalapeño and sauté 5 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and sauté 1-2 minutes until fragrant. Stir in the flour and sauté 1 minute.

Gradually add the chicken stock while stirring. Stir in the chicken, green chiles, beans, corn, cumin, and oregano. Bring to a simmer, reduce heat to medium-low, and simmer 5 minutes. Add the milk and simmer 5 minutes more.
Season generously with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve warm topped with preferred garnishes.

notes: Rotisserie chicken saves time. Milk keeps this creamy without heaviness; heavy cream may substitute for a richer texture.
